title: tariff
description: EWDS topic: ontology Tariff (Blooo owns the class). Per-community / per-UsagePoint network charges for grid fee, levies, taxes and incentives. Energy trade price remains on Trade (REQ-003); energyPrice here is the tariff catalogue rate when published. DRAFT — to submit to EWAG (INT-440).

tariffId.description: Primary identifier. UUID v4. IRI: int:tariffId.

communityId.description: FK to the Community this tariff applies to.

gridId.description: FK to Grid / UsagePoint (ontology hasTariff). Null when the tariff is community-wide.

validUntil.description: Exclusive end of validity; null = open-ended.

energyPrice.description: Catalogue energy price per kWh when published on the tariff sheet. Trade prices remain authoritative for billing (REQ-003).

networkTariff.description: Network / grid fee per kWh (ontology gridFee / networkTariff).

levies.description: Levies per kWh (Blooo extension to submit to EWAG).

incentives.description: Incentives per kWh (ontology incentives). Negative = credit to the participant.

structure.description: Tariff structure: flat per-kWh or time-of-use.
